versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the evt-dvt-pvt-gate-review skill.
- Supports structured phase-gate reviews for EVT, DVT, and PVT in hardware NPI.
- Produces a detailed gate review document: exit-criteria scoring, yield analysis, open-issue triage, waiver register, and a go/conditional-go/no-go recommendation.
- Enforces rigorous review standards: no assumed passes, every waiver documented with discipline, and station-by-station yield breakdowns.
- Includes a reference framework for common criteria and best practices to prevent common review pitfalls.
